heading: We are taking care of the Last-Mile Delivery !

blocks.html: Espoirer ( espoirer.com ↗︎ ) is a logistics company that leverages automation and digitalization to enhance the delivery process. With the rapid development of the smart logistics revolution, Espoirer is committed to solving the challenges of Japanese logistics industry by offering a one-stop global product distribution service, with a focus on cross-border e-commerce.

blocks.alt: Espoirer — We are taking care of the Last-Mile Delivery !

blocks.html: For the whole project, we designed an iOS and Android mobile application from 0 to 1 for Espoirer staff, courier managers and the delivery drivers.
While several other designers focused on features related to Search, Out For Delivery, Ticket system and more. In the design process, I contributed by structuring and providing creative ideas.

I am the design owner of two features in the whole delivery system 1.Scan - To - Task Process & 2.Homepage on the driver end, aiming to streamline the task management and delivery workflows with an intuitive interface.
